title: A slow reveal from your pictures
summary: A video that moves slowly across your pictures, with captions if you want them.
text: Make a video that moves slowly across these pictures, in this order, fading from one to the next: [pictures]. Give each picture a few seconds. If captions are given, put each on its picture in plain readable type: [captions]. Use only pictures the owner named. The video is at most two minutes long and at most full HD in size. Look at the stills before you hand it over.
